meta.name: handoff
meta.description: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档（handoff document / session handoff brief），供下一个 agent 接续工作。手动调用 /handoff。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩对话为交接文档，让下一个 agent 无缝接续工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个 agent 之间传递上下文，避免重复沟通
copy.tagline_en: Compress conversation into handoff document for seamless agent handover
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pass context between multiple agents to avoid repetition

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以生成一份交接文档，总结当前对话的背景、已完成工作、待办事项等，供下一个 AI 接续工作。
howto.when: 当你手动输入 /handoff 命令时触发。如果对话少于3轮实质交流，Claude 会建议不生成，除非你坚持。

say.text: 请生成交接文档，重点放在 API 集成测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份以 API 测试为重点的交接文档。
Claude 会生成交接文档，重点为用户注册功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a handoff document summarizing the current conversation's background, completed work, and next steps for another agent to continue.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you manually type /handoff. If the conversation has fewer than 3 substantive exchanges, Claude will suggest skipping unless you insist.

say_en.text: Generate a handoff document focusing on API integration testing.
say_en.note: Claude will create a handoff document with emphasis on API testing.
Claude will generate a handoff document focused on user registration.
